initial_receipt.explanation: The downstream priority ordering lost all upstream provenance rank information because the evidence_sources handoff used source IDs as record_id values. Job 2 received evidence_sources records with record_id values s01 through s08, while coverage records are keyed by n06-r01 through n06-r08, so prioritize could not match ranks and every upstream_rank became 0. The exact-hash handoff evidence shows Job 2 consumed the upstream artifact as produced, localizing the identity corruption to Job 1. The upstream assemble_provenance function is responsible because it constructs each provenance row with record_id set to record.get('source_id', '') instead of preserving the demand record_id.
